scope: Geometry/material visual acceptance; diagnostic PNGs are 640px/16 samples, except 128px silhouette and 512px GLB roundtrip. Shared final hero refinement is recorded separately.

identification.reason: High columnar trunk, three levels of apical dichotomy and narrow leaves on young axes clearly differ from the conifer. Diamond leaf cushions read in hero and orthographic views.

form_integrity.reason: Front, side, rear, top and opposite three-quarter views show coherent volumes and deliberate buried intersections, with no unintended spikes, detached parts or open solid surfaces.

planes_and_lighting.reason: Neutral clay, reversed key light and actual triangle wireframes show stable broad planes. Exact GLB re-import shows no new critical creases or missing faces.

family_consistency.reason: Fixed original palette, flat shading, shared rig, measured meter scale and category-specific silhouette match the package contract.

scientific_context.reason: Metadata explicitly labels an evidence-informed stylized concept, separates Carboniferous and Mesozoic context, and records artistic choices.

silhouette_proportion.reason: The tall column and high open dichotomous crown have a distinct category silhouette.

planes_rhythm.reason: Broad trunk and fork planes remain quiet around the localized cushion pattern.

color_material.reason: Mature bark, younger branches and foliage form anatomical color groups.

craft.reason: Closed narrow leaves and raised cushions remain stable in the exact GLB re-import.

family_reuse.reason: Explicit Carboniferous-only context, meter-scale origin and five semantic editable objects.

completed_visual_revisions: Simplified leaf-cushion geometry and increased structural bark contrast.
Enlarged the young-branch leaves without changing their narrow simple-leaf construction.
Continued the mature bark group into the first crown fork to avoid an arbitrary trunk color cutoff.
limitations: Exact crown stage, leaf count and display dimensions are artistic choices.
Fine subsurface stigmarian rootlets are omitted; the shallow visible root seat is simplified.
remaining_external_verification: Three.js runtime and combined-gallery performance are owned by the integration task; not certified by these Blender images.
